record.body:
# DPT wild-hunt verification: results

**Screening complete. No tested implementation survived.** Seven named candidates were operationalized in eight score channels, followed by three pins-only banded retests (#27). All eleven score tests are **KILLED** under the frozen protocol. This rejects these specific measurements for instrument admission; it does not disprove TSE, information theory, optimal transport, or any other parent field.

Manna: mn-c2d546. Report only. Production DPT, registry and `wild-hunt.md` are unchanged. No new dependency, public verb, scoring integration or commit. The issue remains claimed and in progress at the work order's explicit no-commit boundary.

## What changes the decision

1. **Do not put any survivor into DPT: there are none.** Three Trees has the strongest registered preference result, 8/10, but p=0.0546875 already misses alpha=0.05 before multiplicity correction (Holm p=0.6015625). Its worst canon-to-negative gap is only 0.001797 against the registered 0.05 margin. Its pin gate is incomplete because historic pin DOMs are absent.
2. **Compression reuse is not enough.** Raster Self-Teaching gives broken 0.105452, above canon-today 0.027355 and canon-dossier 0.045960. The HTML channel gives barf 0.508021, above both canon fixtures. Its targeted raster ordering also fails: D1 0.028013 < B1 0.060646. The HTML channel orders that pair correctly, but fails both Null traps. The cross-round D1/B1 comparison has different capture lengths and is a supplemental falsifier only.
3. **The TSE mapping needs conceptual repair before any new taste claim.** The tested feature-covariance proxy gives broken 3.137976, above both canons (1.907127 and 1.579979), and Pete's Pasta 1.740048. A plain white image scores 2.406769, also above both canons. Shared color/gradient descriptor structure creates apparent integration even in that blank image. A static descriptor covariance is not a neural dynamical ensemble. This result kills the implemented mapping, not the neuroscience formalism.
4. **Bands can pass controls while failing taste.** The pins-only squint interval passes fixtures, both Null traps and all four available pins, but records only 1/10 strict preference wins. Most within-band specimens tie. This is why the human-feedback gate cannot be replaced by attractive fixture results.

## Frozen gate results

A = both liked-direction canon fixtures above both negative controls by the registered margin. B = all ten fixed preference pairs, one-sided binomial test with Holm correction across eleven tests. C = Null at/above the other four candidates' median in both surfaces. D = all four available pin screenshots above the negative-control band. I = incomplete, never a pass.

| Implementation | A | B wins | Raw p | Holm p | C | D | Verdict |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| #17 TSE feature proxy | FAIL | 2/10 | 0.989258 | 1.000000 | FAIL | FAIL | KILLED |
| #18 Three Trees | FAIL | 8/10 | 0.054688 | 0.601562 | PASS | INCOMPLETE | KILLED |
| #1 Self-Teaching, raster | FAIL | 6/10 | 0.376953 | 1.000000 | FAIL | FAIL | KILLED |
| #1 Self-Teaching, HTML | FAIL | 5/10 | 0.623047 | 1.000000 | FAIL | INCOMPLETE | KILLED |
| #10 Squint trajectory | FAIL | 2/10 | 0.989258 | 1.000000 | FAIL | FAIL | KILLED |
| #23 Emphasis transport | FAIL | 1/10 | 0.999023 | 1.000000 | FAIL | INCOMPLETE | KILLED |
| #13 Loom rank | FAIL | 3/10 | 0.945312 | 1.000000 | FAIL | INCOMPLETE | KILLED |
| #14 Size chord | FAIL | 6/10 | 0.376953 | 1.000000 | FAIL | INCOMPLETE | KILLED |
| #27 banded TSE | FAIL | 2/10 | 0.989258 | 1.000000 | FAIL | FAIL | KILLED |
| #27 banded Self-Teaching | FAIL | 4/10 | 0.828125 | 1.000000 | FAIL | FAIL | KILLED |
| #27 banded squint | PASS | 1/10 | 0.999023 | 1.000000 | PASS | PASS | KILLED |

No result sits in a pending BANDED-RETEST state: all three predeclared bands were actually run and failed. Candidates #2-9, #11-12, #15-16, #19-22, #24-26 and #28 remain **NOT TESTED**. The Reliquary was not revived.

## Effect sizes and exact evidence

Higher is better for every channel, including negative rank/roughness scores. Units differ; values must not be compared across rows. A positive gap below its predeclared margin still fails.

| Implementation | Canon Today | Canon Dossier | Barf | Broken | Worst fixture gap | Required margin |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| #17 TSE feature proxy | 1.907127 | 1.579979 | 1.767189 | 3.137976 | -1.557997 | 0.010000 |
| #18 Three Trees | 0.398355 | 0.371307 | 0.369510 | 0.154389 | 0.001797 | 0.050000 |
| #1 Self-Teaching, raster | 0.027355 | 0.045960 | 0.027304 | 0.105452 | -0.078097 | 0.010000 |
| #1 Self-Teaching, HTML | 0.286245 | 0.132497 | 0.508021 | 0.107111 | -0.375525 | 0.010000 |
| #10 Squint trajectory | 0.990379 | 0.994577 | 0.986288 | 0.975911 | 0.004091 | 0.010000 |
| #23 Emphasis transport | 0.752890 | 0.857723 | 0.942706 | 0.774762 | -0.189816 | 0.010000 |

| #27 banded TSE | 0.000000 | -0.108407 | 0.000000 | 0.000000 | -0.108407 | 0.010000 |

| #27 banded squint | 0.000000 | 0.000000 | -0.210861 | -1.372430 | 0.210861 | 0.010000 |

Each raw score's `details` includes its measurement components: TSE subset-size curve, the three MI agreements, all three compressed sizes, blur divergences, transport distributions, effective rank or chord counts. `scores.json` includes every pair's exact gap, success flag, label role, round, confidence interval and required denominator.

### Round and label census

80 specimens indexed. 69 retained for evaluation: 68 have image evidence, and 64 have reconstructed HTML plus a current renderer DOM probe. Pin 002 is still an explicit missing specimen. Eleven specimens are excluded from scoring: three disputed Round 7 candidates, six unruled reground candidates, and two Engine Round 4 refinements without an exact bound specimen-level ruling.

| Corpus group | Indexed | Human-label handling |
|---|---:|---|
| concept | 10 | today-C and dossier-D winners; other siblings unselected, not invented kills |
| concept2 | 10 | both complete trap sets; Library Null compared to two explicit rejections |
| lib3 | 11 | paneldock provisional winner vs four explicit rejections |
| lib4 | 3 | askhero winner; other siblings unnoted |
| eng3 | 4 | oneline and timetable2 advanced vs ledgerfirst rejected |
| eng4 | 2 | two refinements retained outside scoring |
| eng5 | 14 | all 14 candidates; no declared winner, hence no manufactured winning pairs |
| eng6 | 8 | M1 advanced and D1 conditional winner vs MC1's rejected arrangement; silent entries not negative votes |
| eng7 | 3 | E2 chat / E3 page conflict; excluded |
| reground | 6 | A/B/C Today and Engine; no recovered final ruling, excluded |
| fixtures | 4 | two liked-direction fixtures plus barf/broken controls |
| pins | 5 | five declared; four screenshots, no matched historic DOMs |

The ten primary pairs span four feedback groups. They compare advancement/preference against explicit rejection of a design or arrangement; they are not ten independent unconditional final-winner decisions. The same preferred page appears in multiple pairs. Therefore the nominal binomial p-values are screening diagnostics, not population inference. The fixed comparison list and exact quotes are in PROTOCOL.md, corpus.json and each round's labels.yaml.

| Implementation | Concept 2 | Library 3 | Engine 3 | Engine 6 | Without provisional/conditional choices | Round sign-flip p |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| #17 TSE feature proxy | 0/2 | 1/4 | 0/2 | 1/2 | 0/5 | 1.000000 |
| #18 Three Trees | 2/2 | 2/4 | 2/2 | 2/2 | 5/5 | 0.125000 |
| #1 Self-Teaching, raster | 1/2 | 4/4 | 0/2 | 1/2 | 2/5 | 0.500000 |
| #1 Self-Teaching, HTML | 0/2 | 4/4 | 1/2 | 0/2 | 1/5 | 0.625000 |
| #10 Squint trajectory | 0/2 | 1/4 | 1/2 | 0/2 | 1/5 | 1.000000 |
| #23 Emphasis transport | 0/2 | 0/4 | 1/2 | 0/2 | 1/5 | 1.000000 |
| #13 Loom rank | 1/2 | 0/4 | 2/2 | 0/2 | 3/5 | 0.875000 |
| #14 Size chord | 1/2 | 4/4 | 0/2 | 1/2 | 2/5 | 0.500000 |
| #27 banded TSE | 0/2 | 1/4 | 0/2 | 1/2 | 0/5 | 1.000000 |
| #27 banded Self-Teaching | 1/2 | 0/4 | 2/2 | 1/2 | 3/5 | 0.750000 |
| #27 banded squint | 0/2 | 1/4 | 0/2 | 0/2 | 0/5 | 1.000000 |

With four groups the sign-flip diagnostic has only 16 assignments and limited resolution. The 5/5 nonconditional Three Trees subset was predeclared for disclosure, not for replacing the ten-pair test after seeing outcomes.

### Trap gaps

Null score minus the other four designs' median. Both surface gaps must be nonnegative. A trap failure rejects the proxy; it does not identify novelty bias as a proven psychological cause.

| Implementation | Library gap | Engine gap |
|---|---:|---:|
| #17 TSE feature proxy | -0.026024 | 0.130155 |
| #18 Three Trees | 0.093007 | 0.077111 |
| #1 Self-Teaching, raster | -0.004091 | 0.003048 |
| #1 Self-Teaching, HTML | -0.046382 | -0.018475 |
| #10 Squint trajectory | -0.002849 | 0.000102 |
| #23 Emphasis transport | -0.048403 | -0.090566 |
| #13 Loom rank | -0.289950 | -0.347571 |
| #14 Size chord | 0.003231 | -0.006010 |
| #27 banded TSE | -0.017625 | 0.088148 |
| #27 banded Self-Teaching | 0.128325 | -0.029097 |
| #27 banded squint | 0.000000 | 0.000000 |

### Pins-only bands

| Base measurement | Low | High | Negative controls inside interval |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| #17 TSE feature proxy | 1.740048 | 3.216596 | barf, broken |
| #1 Self-Teaching, raster | -0.001252 | 0.030630 | barf |
| #10 Squint trajectory | 0.988171 | 0.997105 | neither |

TSE's pin interval contains both negative controls; Self-Teaching's contains barf. Their register gate cannot separate those controls. Squint excludes both controls but largely flattens the real design comparisons into ties. All band parameters came only from the four pins. Pin passage for a pins-fitted band is calibration, not independent validation.

### TSE limiting-case diagnostics

| Constructed raster | Score |
|---|---:|
| independent_noise | 0.244888 |
| cloned_texture | 2.406769 |
| modular_texture | 7.810990 |
| white | 2.406769 |

These controls expose how the specific descriptor ensemble behaves, including shared channel/gradient structure. They were predeclared diagnostics and did not alter any score, threshold or label. The mathematical correlation identity control is exactly zero; the moderate block-correlated control is 0.497034 and the near-cloned-variable control is 2.406769. Do not transfer a neural-complexity interpretation to this image proxy.

## Provenance and limitations

- Recovered 261 source/asset versions from 141 transcript files, plus seven complete saved artifact galleries. Every source version has a hash and transcript/tool-result receipt in recovery.json. No recorded shell command was executed. Successful Write/Edit replay was exact; zero edits required guessing.
- Gallery image bytes supersede transcript thumbnails. M3's gallery image differs from its Read image; the gallery version was selected before scoring. One nominal .png Read carried JPEG bytes, which remain correctly typed and attributed.
- Auction Lot is dossier-D, verified from the original gallery title/IMG placeholder and blind key, not from a recap. Library Round 3's paneldock preference and Library Round 4's askhero win remain distinct. Round 7's conflict remains unresolved.
- Early round captures are 1440x900 viewports. Round 6 consists of full-page 1920-wide captures of different lengths. Pins are still longer full pages. The 360-pixel analysis width preserves aspect ratio but cannot remove content-length or capture-policy confounds. The 24-region TSE partition stretches across each whole capture.
- DOM measurements are fresh probes of recovered HTML, clipped to historical image extent. They are not verified pixel-identical historical browser states. Unused font subsets can remain unloaded; no font load errors or broken image loads were observed in the 64 probes. No historical DOM exists for the pin captures. No current live page was quietly substituted.
- DOM containment is not semantic truth. Minimum partition agreement does not know whether MC1's connectors represent real flow; area/heading weights do not know business importance. The implementations test declared proxies only.
- The corpus is one person's selected examples, not an independent aesthetic population. There is no learned aesthetic judge, no holdout claim for the pin-fitted bands, no manufactured uncertainty band, and no adjustment after scores.

## Verification and reproduction

Ten analytic/regression checks passed: independence and modular integration, finite constant-raster output, partition identity/independence, compression prefix behavior, missing-evidence refusal, tie/denominator handling, multiplicity family retention, browse close's text contract, and JSON scalar/NaN handling. 237 frozen input/code files and all protected paths verified after the successful run. A full replay from those frozen inputs exactly reproduced every score, component detail, gate, band and TSE diagnostic (verification.json). No production source changed; the repository-wide test.sh suite was not run for this isolated research artifact.

The initial full run failed at JSON serialization of a NumPy integer before writing or inspecting score values. The original freeze is retained. AMENDMENT-serialization.md and serialization-amendment.json identify the three changed files: JSON boundary, freeze-record selection/console count, and the regression test. metrics.py, PROTOCOL.md, config.json, labels and input evidence hashes were unchanged. The second immutable seal preceded the successful rerun.

- Protocol registration UTC: `2026-09-08T19:11:07.497391+00:00`
- Corrected run freeze UTC: `2026-09-08T19:22:57.672001+00:00`
- Results UTC: `2026-09-08T19:23:45.543311+00:00`
- Protocol SHA-256: `57e2fdc11f6110c7450c9dc8f6362fb5f46a94c3903dd3f1f5cda4bc2ddb8a2a`
- Scores SHA-256: `1d5b8b8d438c50c7c6c981ebbd614267f2a9be7b2c4610e8b1b8067b6acddfe8`
- Runtime: Python 3.10.21, NumPy 1.26.2, SciPy 1.15.2, Pillow 9.5.0, Zstd 1.5.7, macOS arm64.

From the repo root, using the existing scientific Python installation:

```bash
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.10 corpus/design-research/wildhunt-verify/test_research.py
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.10 corpus/design-research/wildhunt-verify/evaluate.py --verify --freeze-record /Users/erik/Custom-Coding/agent-do/corpus/design-research/wildhunt-verify/freeze-serialization-fix.json
```

To recompute without replacing the recorded results, pass the same freeze record plus `--out` pointing to a new file under `.dev/dpt-wildhunt/`. All observed inputs, settings and component values accompany the report. Capture regeneration uses capture.py through agent-do browse and creates a new observational state; do not overwrite the frozen probes for a replication.

Mathematical source receipts and operational definitions are in [PROTOCOL.md](PROTOCOL.md), including [TSE's original paper](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8197179/), [Gaussian neural complexity analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/1011.5334), [Meila's partition-comparison paper](https://sites.stat.washington.edu/mmp/Papers/icml05-compare-axioms.pdf), [Zstandard](https://facebook.github.io/zstd/zstd_manual.html), and [Hou/Zhang spectral residual saliency](https://bcmi.sjtu.edu.cn/home/zhangliqing/Papers/2007CVPR_Houxiaodi_04270292.pdf). These sources establish the underlying methods, not that the proposed aesthetic applications work.

## Completion boundary

The authorized screening and report are complete. No surviving position is entered into ZPC, and no candidate is admitted to DPT. Lessons logged: 11 (new) | Decisions logged: 0 (new). Eight instructive candidate/banding failures and three recovery/export lessons are recorded in ledger-receipts.json and the project ledger. The Manna claim is retained until Erik's explicit commit instruction, as required by this work order. Remaining generation candidates and any revised operationalizations are optional future research, not unfinished requirements for this screening wave.

**TL;DR (12th grade):** The evidence was recovered and the first seven proposed measures were tested under rules written before scoring. None qualified. Three Trees tracked some of your preferences but missed its pass requirements; compression and several other formulas rewarded rejected designs. Pins-only bands could pass simple controls while missing actual design choices. Keep DPT unchanged and treat this as evidence against these implementations, not a verdict on all possible mathematics of taste.

# Wild-hunt verification: frozen screening protocol

Issue: mn-c2d546. Written before computing any candidate score, 2026-09-08.
This is a local preregistration, not an independently registered study. `freeze.json`
records this file and the input/code hashes before evaluation; the run refuses drift.
`wild-hunt.md` is a frozen generation artifact with zero evidential standing.

## Scope and authority

Report only. No production DPT, registry, command, dependency, or model changes.
Run #17, #18, #1 first, then #10, #23, #13, #14. A pins-only #27 retest is
precommitted for the raster scores #17, #1, #10, whether they pass or fail.
The remaining generation candidates are NOT TESTED, not killed by association.
No commits until Erik authorizes a commit. No change to the task's Manna lifecycle
to imply accepted delivery while that boundary is pending.

Published mathematics motivates these operationalizations; it does not establish
that any of them measures taste. A killed proxy does not disprove its parent field.

## Corpus and labels

`corpus.json` and each `corpus/rounds/<round>/labels.yaml` contain the exact quotes,
source paths, original gallery keys, and file hashes. JSON syntax is YAML 1.2.
Preserve all specimens, including missing, unnoted, conditional, and conflicting ones.

Original saved gallery pixels take precedence over transcript Read thumbnails.
Transcript HTML is recovered only from successful tool results and exact edits,
without executing recorded shell commands. Native full-page and viewport captures
remain distinct. Captured DOM is a present renderer's view of the recovered HTML,
not a claim that its font rasterization or script state matches historical pixels.
DOM probes use the archived image width and retain only nodes intersecting that
image's extent. No live-site DOM is substituted for an old pin screenshot.

Grounding corrections made before scoring:

- Paper Broadsheet = today-C; Auction Lot = dossier-D, verified against gallery
  card titles and IMG placeholders, plus the round's blind key. Named `canon-*`
  fixtures are a liked direction, not ratified final designs (fixture README).
- Library Round 3 has a provisional paneldock winner and four explicit rejections;
  askhero wins Library Round 4. These are different rounds, not interchangeable wins.
- Engine Round 5 has no winner. Its 14 candidates stay in the corpus, but cannot
  manufacture a within-round winning pair. B1 remains a targeted structural kill.
- M2, M3, MC2 and other silent entries are unnoted, not invented negative votes.
- Round 7 is entirely excluded: E2 chat ruling conflicts with E3 page feedback.
  Reground A/B/C has no recovered final ruling and is also excluded from scoring.
- Five pins remain declared. Four have screenshots; 002/every.to is unavailable.
  Pin 005's original signup overlay remains part of its captured specimen.

### Fixed primary comparisons

These ten ordered comparisons are selected from human feedback, before scores:

| Round | Preferred/advanced | Rejected comparators | Pairs |
|---|---|---|---:|
| Concept 2, Library | library-B, The Null | library-D, library-A | 2 |
| Library 3 | paneldock, provisional winner | market, deltas, statled, quiet | 4 |
| Engine 3 | oneline and timetable2, both advanced | ledgerfirst | 2 |
| Engine 6 | M1 and D1, conditional winner | MC1's explicitly rejected arrangement | 2 |

These test **advancement/preference over an explicitly rejected arrangement**, not
ten unconditional final-winner decisions. The exact quote always outranks that role.
Also report the subset without provisional/conditional preferences. Round 1 and
Library 4 winners have unselected siblings, not explicit negative quotes; any
winner-vs-unselected ordering is descriptive only and never enters the primary test.

The work order's cross-round D1 > B1 prediction for #1 is a separate falsifier,
never smuggled into the within-round denominator. Different native capture lengths
are a confound for that pair, reported alongside the result.

## The four gates, fixed for every score

Higher score is always better. `config.json` gives each practical margin. Margins
are declared experimental screening choices, not published beauty thresholds.

1. **A, fixtures:** min(score(canon-today), score(canon-dossier)) minus
   max(score(barf), score(broken)) must meet the declared margin. Report all four
   values and the gap; a tie does not pass.
2. **B, rounds:** all ten fixed pairs must be measurable. A strict preferred >
   rejected is one success; a numerical tie counts as failure. Compute the exact
   one-sided binomial tail against p=0.5, alpha=0.05 (work-order authority).
   Apply Holm correction across the eleven predeclared score tests, including
   both #1 channels and three #27 retests. Missing tests receive p=1, never leave
   the family. Report raw p, adjusted p, accuracy and exact binomial interval.
   Reused specimens make pairs dependent: these are screening diagnostics, not
   independent population trials. Report per-round rates and an exact round-level
   sign-flip sensitivity (all 2^R flips of each round's centered success sum).
   That sensitivity is a limitation check, not a post-hoc replacement gate.
3. **C, trap:** in EACH of Library and Engine, its Null must score at least the
   median of the four non-Null conceits. Require all ten trap specimens. Equality
   passes this gate only. A fail instantly kills the operationalization as a taste
   candidate; it does not by itself prove the psychological cause is novelty bias.
4. **D, register:** all four available archived pins must exceed the maximum of
   barf/broken by the candidate's declared margin. Always report 4/5 screenshot
   availability. DOM-dependent scores have 0/4 matched pin DOMs and this gate is
   INCOMPLETE, not vacuously true and not evidence of a style failure.

No missing datum becomes zero or disappears from a required denominator.
Any observed gate failure yields KILLED for that tested implementation, even if
another gate is incomplete. A score with no failure but incomplete coverage is
INCOMPLETE, never SURVIVED SCREENING. Only complete passage of all gates can yield
SURVIVED SCREENING. BANDED-RETEST names only the predeclared pending #27 operation;
once run, its actual pass/fail replaces that pending status. No threshold changes.

## Implementations and declared numerical authority

All experimental settings live in `config.json` and cite this section. They are
chosen before data scores, not claimed natural constants. No output/result caps.
Source image sizes, DOM counts, subset counts, compressor windows and permutation
enumerations derive from measured input or the fixed design below.

Shared raster: white-composite alpha; RGB bytes decoded from the original PNG/JPEG.
The common analysis width is the minimum available archived evaluation width
divided by the grid's column count, preserving aspect ratio. No screenshot crop,
popup cleanup, aesthetic model, OCR, or learned preference score. `uint8` range
derives from the image representation. Float tolerance = 64 machine epsilons,
a numerical equality convention, not an effect margin.

### Wave 1

**#17 TSE Gaussian feature proxy.** Grid = 4 columns x 6 rows = 24 regions, meeting
the work-order minimum. Normalize each region to 32 x 32 samples (experimental
spatial resolution). Feature vector = RGB and finite-difference luminance gradient
magnitude, concatenated at corresponding relative positions. Mean RGB defines
luminance here; this is a deterministic texture descriptor, not a vision model.
Each region is a variable, descriptor positions/channels are the ensemble. Form
the correlation matrix, zero-variance regions independent, and shrink toward the
identity by 1/descriptor_length (one pseudocount per observed feature). Gaussian
integration I(S) = -0.5 log det R(S). Score = mean over k=1..N-1 of
`(k/N)*I(all) - mean(I(S_k))`. For each k, use N subsets drawn without replacement
within each subset, fixed RNG seed derived from SHA-256 of the issue ID. The same
subsets apply to all pages. This is a sampled, static-image covariance proxy;
descriptor coordinates are not time observations, and no causal integration or
neuroscientific interpretation is inferred. Emit the whole subset-size curve.
Checks: identity correlation gives zero; block-correlated variables give positive
complexity; constant-image computation remains finite. Report cloned texture and
independent noise controls as diagnostics without using them to tune the score.

**#18 Three Trees proxy.** Visible leaf text nodes and visual leaves (img/svg/canvas),
not nested double-counted ancestors. Geometry = normalized box center. Style =
font size, weight, foreground RGB, background RGBA and categorical family one-hot;
standardize nonconstant columns within the page. Semantic partition = nearest
structural ancestor (section/article/nav/aside/header/footer/form/table), else the
element's parent. This is DOM containment, **not ground truth about meaning**.
Ward clustering for geometry/style with K=round(sqrt(N)), derived from node count.
Compare their two partitions and the DOM partition using arithmetic normalized MI
`2*MI/(H1+H2)`. Primary score = minimum of the three agreements. Single-group or
all-singleton semantic partitions are uninformative and produce missing, not a
perfect score. Also emit each raw MI and entropy. MC1 and B1 are targeted probes,
but human semantic truth about a connector is not guaranteed by its DOM ancestry.

**#1 Self-Teaching.** Split the normalized raster into top and bottom halves, dropping
only a possible unmatched final row so both strips have equal dimensions. On decoded
RGB strip bytes, score `[C(top)+C(bottom)-C(top||bottom)]/C(bottom)` using installed
zstd's default compression level, single thread, with back-reference window derived
as ceil(log2(total bytes)) so the compressor can reach the prefix. Store component
sizes. Separately report the same calculation on PNG-encoded strips as a diagnostic:
compressing already compressed PNG bytes is not the primary visual signal.
The HTML channel uses the captured leaf outerHTML in document order, split by
vertical midpoint of the historical image extent. Scripts/head/CSS are excluded;
there is no arbitrary byte-midpoint split through a stylesheet. Empty halves are
missing. Both channels are reported separately; #1 survives only if BOTH pass.
Additional kill: D1 must exceed B1 in each channel, per generation record #1.

### Wave 2

**#10 squint trajectory proxy.** Gaussian blur at 0 and dyadic pixel scales from 1
through half the region sampling width (32/2). For each level, pool gradient mass
into the fixed region grid, normalized to a probability distribution. Score = 1
minus mean Jensen-Shannon divergence between adjacent levels, normalized by log(2).
Uniform zero-gradient fields get a uniform distribution, explicitly a possible
blankness confound. No response-dependent scale selection.

**#23 emphasis transport proxy.** Spectral-residual saliency: FFT log amplitude minus
a 3 x 3 local mean, retain phase, inverse FFT, squared magnitude, Gaussian smooth
sigma=1. The local mean kernel follows Hou/Zhang's spectral-residual construction;
this implementation is a fixed proxy, not a claim to reproduce their benchmarks.
Pool saliency into the region grid. Target mass = visible text/image box area times
heading importance (1/heading level, body = 1/(number of HTML heading levels + 1)).
That importance rule is an experimental target, not a human meaning oracle.
Compute optimal transport exactly via linear programming between grid centroids,
cost = Euclidean distance / page diagonal. Score = 1 - transport cost. Requires
matched DOM availability and fails closed when either distribution is empty.

**#13 loom rank proxy.** Binary incidence of visible leaf boxes at rounded CSS-pixel
top/left coordinates, no cap on rows/elements. Effective rank = exp(entropy of
normalized singular values). Score = negative effective rank / sqrt(node count).
This tests low-dimensional layout organization, with simple/blank structure a known
confound; no claim that rank alone establishes intentionality.

**#14 size chord proxy.** Font-size ratios between all distinct text sizes, weighted
by their DOM frequency products. Roughness is absolute log2 distance to the nearest
positive rational p/q with p,q from 1 through 8 (fixed low-order harmonic vocabulary,
an experimental assumption). Score = negative weighted mean roughness. One unique
size has zero roughness, an explicit monotony confound. No fonts means missing.
Column-width and gap chords are outside this narrow operationalization.

**#27 pins-only bands.** For #17, raster #1, #10 independently, freeze a closed
interval from the min/max of the four pin scores. Banded score = negative distance

# Serialization-only amendment after the first execution

The first execution finished both measurement waves but failed while writing JSON:
`TypeError: Object of type int64 is not JSON serializable`. No score file was written
and no score values or gate verdicts were inspected. Progress output listed specimen
IDs only. The failed attempt is disclosed, not treated as a successful receipt.

Cause: a comparison with NumPy's epsilon yields a NumPy boolean, and summing those
booleans yields a NumPy integer. The JSON boundary accepted only Python scalars.

Repair: `catalog.write_json` converts only NumPy scalars with `.item()`, preserving
numeric and Boolean values, and rejects nonfinite JSON numbers. A regression test
checks counts, false values, decimals and NaN rejection. `evaluate.py` accepts an
explicit immutable freeze-record path so the original `freeze.json` remains intact;
the console summary casts its count to a Python integer. No formula, label, pair,
threshold, feature setting, metric implementation or protocol text changed.

The corrected complete run uses `freeze-serialization-fix.json`, created before its
execution. `preregistration.json` still fixes the original PROTOCOL/config hashes.
The original and amended code-hash differences are recorded in
`serialization-amendment.json`. No failed result is relabeled as successful.
